en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a seafront street with large European-style buildings on the right and a promenade or quay on the left, likely a harbor area. People walk along the waterfront and gather near the buildings; horse-drawn vehicles are visible. The sky is cloudy and dramatic. Printed captions at the bottom identify the location as Smyrna and mention 'Le Sporting Club'. A website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' appears across the lower right.
